Cardinal Health Canada does not manufacture or sell consumer smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or continuous glucose monitors (CGMs)
. Instead, through the
Cardinal Health Canada Online Store
, they distribute traditional blood glucose test strips and meters, alongside professional clinical electrocardiography products like
Cardinal Health Canada Electrocardiography
electrodes and hospital-grade vital signs monitoring equipment.
Cardinal Health Canada Offerings
Blood Glucose:
Distributes standard point-of-care blood glucose meters and testing strips (such as Accu-Chek and Contour lines) rather than consumer-style continuous glucose monitors (CGMs).
ECG and Cardiac Care:
Manufactures medical-grade ECG electrodes and single-patient cable systems (like Kendall DL) for clinical and hospital settings rather than wearable ECG smartwatches.
Patient Monitoring:
Supplies clinical vital sign monitors, thermometers, and diagnostic hardware rather than consumer sleep trackers or remote consumer lifestyle wearables.
